text: Let me start by running tests on all five pages.
I'm still working through the five runs. Careers and missions have finished, and the other three are queued or running. I'm answering the open questions and waiting on the rest.
I'm still working. The NACA page run is done, so I'm answering its open questions. The KSC history page is still running.

I tested all five pages. A few criteria are still open, and I did not run the follow-up multiple-ways check (2.4.5) or the 5.D run for the missions page. These results are agent-assisted and are not a certified Trusted Tester result.

**Failures found on every page**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** There is no skip link, and the "Explore", "News & Events" and "Multimedia" header buttons don't skip the repeated header. This failed on careers, missions, artemis-iii and ksc-history. The NACA page's skip test was incomplete, so it is NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions:** The header "Search" box has only gray placeholder text as its label. This failed on all five pages.

**Other results**
- **Missions, 1.3.1:** The filter checkboxes ("Active", "Future", and so on) are not grouped with their headings such as "MISSION STATUS". I checked 56 of 101 form fields. The remaining 45 weren't checked in detail.
- **Artemis-III, 2.4.7:** The "Hide player controls" button shows no visible focus change.
- **NACA, 2.4.7:** The tool confirmed a failure but I didn't see which element failed. I named the video player's "Hide player controls" buttons as a best guess.

**Why many results are NEEDS_REVIEW**
- **2.2.2:** The pages set timers or poll for updates that outlast the roughly 6.5-second watch window. On the NACA page, movement was detected and I left it unresolved.
- **2.4.3 and 2.4.7:** I could not judge the focus-order or focus-style screenshots, because the crops were too small or dark. I answered "unsure" on them.
- **3.2.4:** On careers and artemis-iii, I could not tell whether the page-specific menu names (such as "Featured Careers" and "Artemis") count as the same control.
- **2.1.1:** Artemis-III and NACA have embedded video frames the tool could not read.
- **1.3.1, 2.4.6 and 4.1.2:** On artemis-iii and NACA, the form fields inside the video frames were not checked. On careers, six textboxes couldn't be tied to their visible text.

The 2.4.5 results are left as NEEDS_REVIEW because I did not run the follow-up with the home page and sitemap.
